name: 房贷等额本息/本金对比

map.🏠 房贷等额本息/本金对比: 🏠 Mortgage: Equal Installment vs Equal Principal
map.一键对比两种还款方式的月供、总利息与资金压力: Compare two repayment methods in one click: monthly payment, total interest and cash-flow pressure
map.📖 查看「房贷等额本息/本金对比 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Mortgage: Equal Installment vs Equal Principal User Guide"
map.等额本息：每月还款额相同，前期利息占比高，总利息较多: Equal installment: the same payment every month, with interest heavy early on and more total interest
map.等额本金：每月本金相同，月供逐月递减，前期压力大，总利息较少: Equal principal: the same principal every month, with payments falling month by month, heavier early and less total interest
map.若计划提前还款，等额本金通常更省利息: If you plan to prepay, equal principal usually saves more interest
map.📚 深度解析：房贷等额本息与等额本金对比: 📚 In-depth: Equal Installment vs Equal Principal Mortgages
map.贷款前对比两种还款方式的总利息与月供压力。: Compare total interest and monthly pressure between the two methods before borrowing.
map.决策时看已还本金与剩余利息。: Decide by looking at the principal already repaid and the interest still outstanding.
map.收入稳定家庭选等额本息、前期宽裕选等额本金。: Households with stable income choose equal installment; those with room early on choose equal principal.
map.等额本息月供≈4,899 元，总利息≈76.4 万；等额本金首月≈6,278 元: Equal installment gives a payment of about 4,899 yuan and total interest of about 764,000; equal principal starts at about 6,278 yuan, falls each month and ends at about 2,779 yuan, with total interest of about 632,000, saving roughly 130,000 against equal installment.
map.同样条件下等额本金首月比等额本息高约 1,379 元，但第 10 年起月供反低于: On the same terms equal principal starts about 1,379 yuan higher, but from year 10 its payment falls below equal installment: it suits those who can carry the early burden and want to save total interest.
map.等额本金总利息更少，但前期月供高；等额本息月供固定、总息略高，按自身现金流选，没: Equal principal costs less total interest but starts higher; equal installment is a fixed payment with slightly more interest. Choose by your own cash flow; neither is universally better.
map.利率变了怎么重算？: How do I recalculate when the rate changes?
map.重新输入新年利率即可，存量房贷一般次年 1 月或按重定价日调整，月供随之变化。: Just enter the new annual rate. Existing mortgages are usually reset the following January or on the repricing date, and the payment changes accordingly.
